headline: Lake Erie go top as Cedarville fall at Tiffin
dek: Lake Erie have won ten matches in all and sit idle on Saturday. Tiffin and Thomas More are behind them, each with a match in hand, and either can still overtake them.
displaced_by: Tiffin beat Cedarville on Oct 22 while Lake Erie beat Northwood, so Cedarville no longer lead the table and the standing headline and dek are untrue

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring is level across the upper half and falls away at the foot: Lake Erie's thirty-two are more than Northwood and Ohio Dominican have scored together.

wire.line: Lake Erie's last match is at home to Tiffin, one of the sides who can still overtake them.

last_match.line: The defeat ends Cedarville's winning run and hands the top of the table to Lake Erie.

next_match.line: The sides drew at Tiffin in September, and after this Tiffin's last match is away to the leaders, Lake Erie.
